title: Preventive Cancer and Well-Woman Screening Schedules
source: Operational Framework for Management of Common Cancers (MoHFW India) & WHO Guidelines

guidelines.title: Routine Cervical Cancer Screening Recommendation
guidelines.why: National guidelines recommend cervical screening (VIA or HPV-DNA) every 5 years for women aged 30-65 to detect cell changes early.
guidelines.nextStep: Ask your nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC) or gynaecologist about free or low-cost cervical screening.

guidelines.title: Annual Clinical Breast Examination (CBE)
guidelines.why: Women aged 30 and older are recommended to receive an annual clinical breast exam by a trained healthcare professional.
guidelines.nextStep: Ask your doctor or trained health worker for a routine clinical breast exam during your next visit.
